grammar: tree-sitter-python.wasm (pinned; 123 unique named node types, nodeTypeCount 274 including anonymous tokens)
_method: Pinned-grammar derivation, not a hand list: node types enumerated through web-tree-sitter's Language API (nodeTypeCount/nodeTypeForId) from wasm/tree-sitter-python.wasm, crossed against the analyzer's own readers and the fixtures that pin each. Shapes below were PROBED on the pinned wasm (decorated_definition/calls/type_alias_statement/raise_statement/with_item/comprehension/walrus/annotation trees) — see .tmp-py/probe-shapes.mjs and the fixtures named in each row. A node type NOT listed here and not in the completeness spec's internal_silent bucket would be a census gap; the census reads zero.

class_definition.heritage: extends: every superclasses argument_list entry that names a base LEAF (identifier, attribute -> LAST identifier, subscript -> generic HEAD); implements: only where the base is PROVEN an interface (ABC/Protocol family, in-file or imported, via the interface-binding pre-pass); metaclass= is a keyword_argument inside superclasses and is NOT a heritage edge (arguments are not base names)
payloads: superTypes metadata (heritage column the store's ancestor walk reads)

function_definition.symbol: function (module scope) | method (class body) | async flag from the anonymous `async` token; a def inside a def is a LOCAL and publishes NO symbol (PY-28)

decorated_definition.symbol: the wrapped class/function keeps its own node; this wrapper is where the DECORATES rows are read
emits: decorates (one row per decorator per decorated symbol, target = decorator name AS WRITTEN: @lib.inject("db") -> lib.inject; arguments are NOT rows; line = the decorator's own line; NO row when the decorated declaration is a local/nested def or a phantom)

type_alias_statement.note: PEP 695 `type Alias = ...`; the alias's RHS type nodes are read as type references like any other annotation position

assignment.symbol: variable (module scope, ownerless) | property (class body, owner class) — locals/params/comprehension targets NEVER symbols
assignment.note: every binding target shape is read through one shared pattern walker: identifier, pattern_list (a, b), tuple_pattern, list_pattern, list_splat_pattern (*rest); annotated assignments carry a type clause -> references

global_statement.symbol: module variable from a `global X` + creating write (ownerless, metadata.boundByGlobalWrite)

for_statement/with_statement/except_clau.symbol: module variable (or class property) from a module/class-scope binder target (metadata.boundByBinder = for|with|except); inside a def they bind LOCALS and publish nothing

expression_statement.relationship: exports via `__all__` (class-body `__all__` is NOT a module export surface)

import_statement / import_from_statement.relationship: imports (`module:item` / `module:*`; future_import_statement stated as module `__future__`; the leading dot of a relative_import is LOCAL by grammar and is never claimed external); metadata.importedAs carries the BOUND alias when it differs; metadata.starImport marks wildcards
import_statement / import_from_statement.note: on a COMPLETE project index (complete===true only): a project-local module's item edge is re-spelled to the bindable ITEM when symbolCounts says declared once; a third-party module's edge carries the moduleNamespace claim

type / generic_type / union_type / membe.relationship: references (annotation positions: parameter/return/annotated assignment; metadata.relationshipType states the position; a PEP-695 inline type_parameter is REFUSED as a reference — inline-type-parameter reason code)
type / generic_type / union_type / membe.note: type clauses whose subtree contains a parser ERROR are refused whole (PY-D17: a confidently-wrong edge is worse than an honest NULL)

type_parameter.relationship: NONE — a PEP-695 `[T]` binding is not a class and is not a reference; pinned as a zero

isinstance/issubclass type arguments.note: a WALRUS/parameter target used as the type argument is a local-binding-target, not a type reference

call.relationship: calls (target = callee LEAF, metadata.qualified = written chain)
call.owner_channel: metadata.owner + metadata.ownerEvidence in {self, annotation, assignment} where the receiver's class-like type is PROVEN; the store resolves members through it (member-owner-resolution.ts) and WITHDRAWS the name binding for those rows
call.not_emitted: a raised exception's type and a decorator's CALL ARGUMENTS are not calls rows of their own; builtin-namespace callees are emitted when the target is not filtered as a builtin call

attribute in a read position.relationship: uses (isMemberRead; target = member leaf, metadata.qualified = written chain; metadata.owner/ownerEvidence where proven; assignment-LHS / augmented-LHS / call-function / receiver-of-call positions are NOT reads)

call with keyword_argument/list_splat/di.relationship: NONE from the argument itself — an argument's NAME (k=) is not a reference, and the class keyword is not heritage

list/dict/set/generator comprehension +.relationship: reads inside the body emit calls/uses/references like any expression; the comprehension's OWN for-target is a LOCAL of its own scope (scopeOwnBindings), so a read of it is local-callee/local-binding-target, never a project-wide name

named_expression (walrus).relationship: the target is a binding (local; or a module/class-scope binding where written at that scope), never a declaration of its own unless a scope binder publishes it; reads of it are bindings

comparison_operator with `in` / `is`.relationship: none (no type/owner evidence in the operator itself)

raise_statement.relationship: NONE of its own — the raised exception is a call edge when written as a call (`raise ValueError(...)` -> calls -> ValueError); a bare `raise E` names no emitted relationship
raise_statement.note: DECLARED: `raises` is a vocabulary candidate this lane does not invent; the census proposal carries the corpus count

lambda.symbol: none (a lambda is a value); its parameters are its OWN scope's locals (scopeOwnBindings)

new/instantiation.relationship: instantiates — a call whose callee is an IN-FILE declared class (declaredTypes), confidence 0.9 with reasonCode in-file-class-constructor; an imported class cannot be proven class-like without a COMPLETE project index

heritage_and_interfaces.extends: class superclasses -> base LEAF; a base the parser cannot name is not emitted; third-party bases carry no claim without proof
heritage_and_interfaces.implements: PROVEN interface bases only: the ABC/Protocol family resolved through the interface-binding pre-pass (in-file declaration or an imported name the file's import proves); plus `SomeABC.register(X)` virtual registration where the receiver is proven an ABC (493 `.register(` spores measured; only proven receivers emit)
heritage_and_interfaces.overrides: in-file base-declares-method, plus the cross-file companion index (AnalyzeContext.overrideCompanion); a base BEYOND the run's reach is NOT guessed (the 76%-wrong first-parent guess was suppressible only because the companion exists)
heritage_and_interfaces.metaclass=: read as a keyword_argument of superclasses; NOT a heritage edge and NOT emitted (a metaclass is a class-level argument, not a base class)

exports_surface.__all__: exports edges from the module to each listed name (PEP 562 __getattr__ provisions published as symbols too); class-body __all__ is not a module export; a shipped submodule / stale export is a DECLARED residual axis, not filtered out

declared: imports module:item claims for project-local modules are suppressed once a COMPLETE index proves the module is the project's own code (the false-claim direction is the one this lane treats as worst)
PEP 695 inline type parameters are not references (pinned)
`__all__` entries supplied by a shipped submodule or by nothing are declared axes (PY-D29/PY-D30), not analyzer gaps
raises / annotates / type_alias relationship values are ontology candidates reported to the census, NOT invented here (decorates was the first admitted and is implemented)
known_declined_or_declared.dynamic_dispatch_wall: self.m()/recv.m() targets keep NO external claim: the receiver's runtime type is not in the file. The owner channel narrows the statically-provable subset (self/annotation/single-assignment); everything else stays an honest unresolved row, measured per evidence class by owner-emission-census.mts

implementation_sites.calls: processCall -> processOneCall (target = callee LEAF, metadata.qualified = written chain; owner channel via memberOwnerInfo)
implementation_sites.contains: analyze() post-walk ownership loop over symbols[].ownerName (class -> member; nested class in class body)
implementation_sites.imports: extractImport (import_statement / import_from_statement / future_import_statement) + applyProjectIndexFacts on complete-index runs
implementation_sites.exports: extractAssignment's module-scope __all__ branch + the PEP 562 __getattr__ provisions publisher
implementation_sites.extends: extractClass base-list walk (base LEAF; dotted base keeps the leaf)
implementation_sites.implements: extractClass interface-binding branch (proven ABC/Protocol) + extractVirtualRegistrations (proven .register receivers)
implementation_sites.instantiates: processOneCall constructor convention (callee Capitalised AND declared in this file's declaredTypes)
implementation_sites.decorates: extractDecoratorReferences (decorated_definition wrapper; normalized through the decorated declaration's published-symbol test)
